codeReview.summary: Worker reduced docs/ from 52 tracked markdown files to 12, well under the ≤20 target. The surviving docs (README index, architecture overview, API reference, developer guide, getting-started, CLI usage, deployment, privacy, MCP README, and 3 changelogs) are well-structured, genuinely useful engineering references that absorbed the best content from the deleted guides. docs/mcp/README.md was preserved untouched (zero diff). The test_documentation.py integration test was updated to validate the new layout and all 306 tests pass with 0 failures. The commit is a single clean diff removing 49 files and ~19,246 lines of redundant/AI-padded content.
